findings.note: The checklist and spec assumptions still say policy values, fixture contents, and evaluation labels are unapproved/to be authored, while approval-provenance records human approval of the linked synthetic policy, 57-case catalogue, and commands. Reconcile the current gate status without extending it beyond synthetic scope or implying measured results.

The policy requires a policy digest matching a fixture-declared digest, but synthetic-fixtures.json declares no such digest. Also, SC-005/T010 require per-citation snapshot/version and record digests while EvidenceItem/SourceSnapshot define only an aggregate snapshot digest. Specify deterministic record canonicalization and the per-citation representation before claiming SC-005 is executable.

Keep these acceptance gaps visible; 28/28 nominal requirement coverage does not demonstrate those assertions or implementation readiness.
